rule: Every private, aggregate, approval, and blocked payment boundary route must pass a visible smoke probe before network learning scales.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, or payment-custody route can pass shared-learning policy.
smoke_principles: Show the tenant-private route and confirm it stays inside organization memory.
Show the aggregate route and confirm only anonymized network patterns can be shared.
Show the approval route and confirm human approval, purpose, audience, anonymization state, and rollback note are present.
Show the blocked payment route and confirm it fails shared-learning policy.
Run role-aware buyer, supplier, and founder probes before shared learning scales.
Keep every smoke result copyable so backend fixtures can mirror the same policy.

private_probe.detail: search and shortlist memory stays tenant-private
lead and renewal memory stays tenant-private

approval_probe.detail: supplier approval exists before visibility change

acceptance: Marketplace shows the Boundary Policy Smoke Console strip after Organization Learning Boundary.
Buyer, supplier, and founder roles each show PASS for private, aggregate, and approval routes.
Buyer, supplier, and founder roles each show BLOCK for payment-custody, booking-commission, or payout routes.
Build Phase shows the v165 Boundary Policy Smoke Console contract after the v164 Organization Learning Boundary contract.
Copy text exports every route, status, role, purpose, and blocked payment signal.
Static checks protect the v165 cache token, UI ids, app functions, CSS selectors, and JSON model.
No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, or payment-custody route can pass shared-learning policy.
